Okay so, um, what I want to build is basically a little service for my climbing gym, they asked me to do this. So the problem is route setters at the gym, they reset the walls like every couple weeks, and right now they track which routes exist on a whiteboard, like literally a whiteboard with magnets. And members keep asking like hey, when was this route set, how hard is it, has anyone done it. So I want, um, I want like a web thing where the setters can log a route in like thirty seconds from their phone, right there on the ladder basically. Photo, grade, color, which wall section, done. And then members scan a QR code at the bottom of the wall and they see the routes on that section, and they can tick the ones they've climbed and leave like a thumbs up or a grade opinion, like "felt harder than V4" kind of thing. It's kind of like, imagine Strava but for indoor bouldering routes, that kind of vibe, the social ticking thing. Oh and the gym has this screen in the lobby, they want a dashboard on it showing like newest routes and most climbed this week. It's one gym, maybe six hundred members, like forty of them climb on a given evening, so nothing crazy. I'm the only one building it, nights and weekends, and honestly I don't want to babysit servers, last thing I want is to be doing ops at midnight. They want it before the spring competition which is in about two months. Um, the setters already use a Google sheet for planning resets so if it could pull the planned reset dates from there that would be sweet but not critical. Photos need to be stored somewhere obviously. And it should feel instant on gym wifi which is, honestly, not great wifi. That's pretty much it I think.
